claims.paraphrase: RA7883 defines BHW status through training and voluntary primary care service after local health board accreditation under DOH guidelines.
claims.use: m4.accreditation-body; do not establish fictional Demi’s eligibility/status

claims.paraphrase: RA7883 requires registration with the city/municipality local health board for benefits under the Act, provides for registry transmission to DOH and appropriate proof of accreditation.
claims.use: Registration and accreditation have distinct qualifications and supporting documents; not interchangeable course certificates

claims.paraphrase: The board safeguards the process, evaluates and acts on applications, records decisions in resolutions/minutes, issues certificates to qualified BHWs, reviews benefits using local funds, recommends benefits/funds, sends registry copies and monitors services.
claims.use: m4.board-duties; cite JMC directly, identify guide’s IRR attribution as secondary

claims.paraphrase: Benefits requiring expenditure of local funds are reviewed and approved by the local health board.
claims.use: Keep benefits review distinct from accreditation decision

claims.paraphrase: The circular defines BHW-RAC as a committee that may be created by LHB. Its specific guidance encourages municipal/city boards to create one; absence or pending creation does not remove the board’s facilitation responsibility.
claims.use: Do not convert may/encouragement into universal mandatory local existence. Palanan’s shall wording is LGU-specific.

claims.paraphrase: The guide describes committee evaluation/interview, recommendation to the board and registry preparation/update. Official Roxas and Marilao orders independently assign those functions within those localities.
claims.use: m4.registration-committee; preserve attribution, never treat recommendation as automatic board approval

claims.paraphrase: Municipal/city health offices facilitate registration/accreditation and prepare/maintain the local registry; RHU provides technical guidance.
claims.use: Bounded fictional question to RHU/municipal or city health office about responsible office, next step, missing information or official board status record

claims.paraphrase: JMC V.F states registration under V.D and at least three immediately preceding years of active voluntary primary care service; it lists an accreditation application form, current-year registration certificate and certified three-year accomplishment report.
claims.use: Verified circular guidance, not invented universal local form/fee/deadline. Avoid collecting private documents; fictional blank cards only. Confirm local implementation.

claims.paraphrase: The circular directs assistance for barangay-appointed workers to undergo registration/accreditation; the label or appointment does not itself bypass the process.
Training is a qualification in the circular, while evaluation, decision and certificate issuance are further process steps.
claims.use: Training certificate alone does not establish completed accreditation

claims.paraphrase: The original facilitator guide recommends three hours for the whole competency. Official TESDA Revision 01 independently allocates one hour to each of its three outcomes, also totaling three hours.
claims.use: Whole competency only; preserve existing 30-minute lesson share and 180-minute module total, label authored teaching splits separately.
